winner.text: Add impression-time request-context features tab, hourmin, and weekday to the existing factorization-machine scorer while keeping architecture, pointwise BCE training, split, and evaluation fixed.
winner.rationale: Training-only screening measured a positive primary lift of 0.00221 for this feature group across all four days, although daily variability was larger than the mean lift. The latest model has GAUC 0.6499 and nDCG@5 0.5272, leaving room for context-sensitive ordering improvements.
winner.exact_ablation: Compare parent experiment 1 using user_id and video_id alone against the same factorization-machine scorer augmented only with tab, hourmin, and weekday.

expected_effect.GAUC: Increase by approximately 0.001 to 0.003, especially for context-dependent users; uncertainty is high because the screening daily standard deviation was 0.00580.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Increase by approximately 0.001 to 0.004, with the largest opportunity in weak context slices such as tab 8 and tab 5.

selection_rationale: Select c01 because it has the strongest measured evidence: request-context features produced a positive screening lift of 0.00221 with full coverage, and gains were positive on all four screening days. It offers a narrow, leakage-safe, low-runtime ablation that preserves the validated architecture, objective, split, and evaluation protocol. Although daily variance lowers confidence, its expected gain and reliability exceed the alternatives, matching the Consultant's top ranking.
